name: command-center-dashboards
title: Command Center Dashboard Pages
description: The 6 dashboard pages, each with its own immersive visual theme: Mission Control (system overview, Ground Control theme), The Hive (scenario ecosystem, Bioluminescent theme), The Forge (engineering velocity, Foundry theme ~90% live data), Ledger (revenue/subscriptions, Vault theme ~60% live), Broadcast (marketing/growth, Signal Tower theme ~40% live), and Panorama (aggregate solar system view, Cosmos theme). Gap metrics render beautifully within each theme as aspirational placeholders rather than broken widgets.
